title: HPP Presence Certificate
description: A signed Presence Certificate issued by the HPP Attestation Server upon successful biometric verification. Delivered by the client directly to the relying party callback endpoint. Page JavaScript receives only cert_id — never the full certificate.

cert_id.description: UUID v4. Unique identifier for this certificate. Relying parties MUST check this against a replay prevention store and reject any second submission within the expiry window.

nonce.description: The single-use challenge nonce that initiated this verification. Binds this certificate to a specific challenge. Relying parties may log this for audit trails.

rp_id.description: eTLD+1 (registrable domain) of the site the user authenticated to. Relying parties MUST verify this equals their own domain before accepting.

server_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Authoritative time from the HPP Attestation Server at challenge issuance. This is the NPHT time anchor.

client_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds from the client device at attestation submission. Informational — not used for security decisions.

credential_id.description: The enrolled platform authenticator credential identifier. Hardware-bound to the user's device.

authenticator_data.description: Raw WebAuthn authenticatorData. rpIdHash(32) | flags(1) | signCount(4) | extensions. UV flag (bit 2) MUST be 1.

assertion_sig.description: ECDSA P-256 signature from the platform authenticator's hardware-bound private key.

client_data_json.description: Base64url-encoded WebAuthn clientDataJSON. Contains type, challenge, origin, crossOrigin.

expiry_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Certificate is invalid at or after this time. Standard lifetime: 3600000ms (1 hour). Re-attestation certificates: 120000ms (2 minutes).

status.description: Certificate status. Only 'issued' is valid. Any other value indicates a server-side error.

hpp_server_sig.description: ECDSA P-256 countersignature from the HPP Attestation Server over the canonical certificate payload. See canonical_signing_payload for reproduction instructions.

action_scope.description: Present only on re-attestation certificates. Contains the hpp-reauth-action value. Null on standard login certificates.

uv_flag.description: True if UV bit was set in authenticator_data. Convenience field — always true for valid HPP certificates.

sign_count.description: Authenticator signature counter. If stored sign_count >= this value, reject as potential replay.

canonical_signing_payload.description: How to reproduce the signed payload for hpp_server_sig verification.
procedure: 1. Construct a JSON object with ONLY the signed_fields listed above
2. Sort keys alphabetically (they already are in the list above)
3. JSON.stringify with no whitespace (no spaces, no newlines)
5. Verify the hpp_server_sig over this payload using the HPP public key

relying_party_verification.description: Steps your backend MUST execute on every certificate before issuing a session. All steps required.

steps.detail: Verify ECDSA P-256 signature over canonical payload against pinned HPP public key
rp_id must exactly equal your site's eTLD+1
Bit 2 of flags byte at offset 32 of authenticator_data must be 1
cert_id must not exist in replay store. After acceptance, store cert_id with TTL = max(0, expiry_ms - now)
If re-attestation, action_scope must match the expected value
